response.query: Studies on provenance of tin in southern African bronzes (1200–1800 CE) combining lead isotopes, tin isotopes, and trace elements to identify geographic sources; interdisciplinary approaches in archaeology, Africa, trace element chemistry, and isotope analysis; recent innovative trends in provenance research, humanities, and arts.
response.answer: Recent studies combine lead, tin isotopes, and trace elements to pinpoint the geographic origins of tin in southern African bronzes from 1200–1800 CE, revealing interdisciplinary archaeological insights. Innovative trends in provenance research utilize advanced isotope analysis and chemistry. These methods identify specific sources and patterns in alloying practices.
